verification.method: Office XML assertions; independent of parser output

legacy_verification.method: Every scored legacy field recomputed from the source file by an independent reader; fields that depend on a parser's conventions are removed and not scored
legacy_verification.reader: xlsx: workbook sheet order, sheet cells, comments, docProps/core.xml
fields: features.text.key_phrases (kept only where verbatim in one source paragraph)

not_scored.element_order: a reading-order sequence in one parser's block granularity
not_scored.tables:xlsx: how many tables a worksheet holds is a parser convention (v2 table_cells assertions cover cells)
not_scored.text.paragraph_count: counts a parser's paragraph segmentation (empty paragraphs, list items, cells), not a source quantity
